Limited company registered in Kenya, with a registered address in Nairobi.
163 James Gichuru Road, Lavington, PO Box 10719-00200 Nairobi Kenya
Says its Protected Area Management offering covers technology and infrastructure, operations rooms and capacity building.

5d-vision: Organisation mentioned alongside the Eagle Club in a source describing the BirdMap portal at birdmap.5dvision.ee.
Co-developed the BirdMap portal with the Eagle Club; the portal runs at birdmap.5dvision.ee.
NGO Kotkaklubi (Eagle Club) and 5D Vision Ltd have developed an online portal birdmap.5dvision.ee, to visualize GPS data of migratory birds.
5g-ai-ecological-soundscape-collector: Soundscape recording device built by the Biodiversity Research Center, Academia Sinica, which TechBang reports was developed with Far EasTone; field validation found AI analysis identified 369 bird and frog species with over 90% accuracy.
TechBang reports the device was developed jointly by Academia Sinica and Far EasTone and identifies the sounds of 369 bird and frog species in real time.
全台首部「5G AI生態聲景蒐集器」能即時分析辨識369種鳥類和蛙類的聲音，中研院與遠傳攜手開發
Field validation by the Academia Sinica team found that AI analysis of its recordings identified 369 bird and frog species with over 90% accuracy.
根據中研院團隊的實地驗證，透過這款裝置再經AI分析，能辨識出369種鳥類和蛙類的聲音，辨識率超過9成。
